text:
Leah: Heads-up 10x HealthCo QBR next Mon. They launched a new pilot last week; finance wants a tight spend forecast and renewal posture.
Sam: I'll run a 30d burn + 2-week projection. Early signs: embed-heavy traffic from a batch job hitting /v1/embeddings every 2h.
Ravi: Quick snapshot: current billing period tokens = 45.2M, avg daily = 1.6M, pilot spike +80% over baseline for last 4 days.
Diego: If spike continues they'll breach their soft threshold in ~9 days. Options: 1) temporary top-up, 2) 1-month commit uplift, 3) apply per-route cost caps. Recommend short-term credits + ask for commit.
FinOps-Bot: alert: HealthCo retainers at 64% of committed; projected burn to commit crossover in 12 days under spike scenario.
Leah: Risk on renewal? finance will push if costs are unpredictable. Product likes the feature.
Ravi: Renewal risk = medium-high unless we present a clear cost-mitigation plan and a predictable commit ask.
Sam: For QBR I'll include three scenarios (baseline, sustained spike, ramp-down) with token/day numbers and cost projections. Will also add a slide with recommended commercial asks phrased for finance.
Leah: Proposed ask: "Propose a 15% short-term retainer increase for the next quarter with a 30-day review; include a 45-minute enablement session for devs to tune embedding params."
Diego: Added temporary 60k credits (expires 10d) to avoid immediate overages and left a note on the account. Drafted an SE checklist: enable prefix caching, lower embed dimension if acceptable, run batch jobs off-peak.
Ravi: Can someone export per-route token distribution and P95 latency for last 14d? I want to show cost/latency tradeoffs.
Sam: I'll export now from Console and attach CSV to the deck.
Leah: Also want a quick customer feedback poll in the QBR: one question on willingness to trade latency for cost savings, another on interest in a short optimization engagement. Link: https://forms.gle/healthco-qbr-poll
FinOps-Bot: note: previous commit history and invoices available at /billing/healthco/2026-02.
Leah: Action items: Sam - deck + projections (due Fri EOD); Ravi - draft renewal blurb and feedback q's; Diego - confirm credits & SE checklist; Leah - schedule QBR and invite finance.
Sam: Will post draft slides here when ready for review.
Ravi: I'll write the renewal blurb and post for quick edit.
Diego: Policy suggestion: auto-throttle on embedding route above 80% retainer and send 48h notice. Want me to add draft to appendix?
Leah: Yes please. Use this thread as canonical QBR-spend ops for HealthCo. :white_check_mark:
